conventions.status: active = listed in fal catalog; deprecated = fal catalog status deprecated; unlisted = schema served but hidden from catalog; removed = schema no longer served; retired-upstream = vendor shut the model down
conventions.keyFields: maps Fuobe canonical slots (prompt,image,images,endImage,video,audio,aspectRatio,resolution,duration,generateAudio,seed,numOutputs,negativePrompt) to the exact field name of that endpoint
conventions.enum.valueType: string means values must be sent as JSON strings (e.g. duration "5"), number means JSON numbers (e.g. duration 5), mixed means e.g. "auto" or 5
conventions.union image_size: fal image_size accepts either an enum preset string or an object {"width":int,"height":int}

fal.auth: Header "Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY" (literally the word Key, not Bearer). Content-Type: application/json.
fal.submit: POST https://queue.fal.run/{endpoint_id} with the model input as the raw JSON body (no "input" wrapper). Full endpoint id incl. sub-path, e.g. https://queue.fal.run/fal-ai/kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-video
fal.statusStream: GET {status_url}/stream?logs=1 -> text/event-stream of the same status objects until COMPLETED
fal.result: GET {response_url} -> model output JSON (model-specific, e.g. {"images":[{"url",...}]} or {"video":{"url",...}}). A failed request returns HTTP 4xx/5xx with {"detail":[{"loc","msg","type",...}]}
fal.subpathMapping: Requests are submitted to the FULL endpoint id, but status/result/cancel live under the app root owner/alias only: https://queue.fal.run/{owner}/{alias}/requests/{request_id}[/status|/status/stream|/cancel]. Example: submit fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/text-to-video -> poll https://queue.fal.run/fal-ai/kling-video/requests/{id}/status. This is what @fal-ai/client 1.10.1 does (parseEndpointId -> owner/alias; namespaces "workflows" and "comfy" add one prefix segment). Safest: always use the status_url/response_url/cancel_url returned by submit.
fal.syncAlternative: POST https://fal.run/{endpoint_id} blocks until done (not recommended for video).
fal.webhooks: POST https://queue.fal.run/{endpoint_id}?fal_webhook={url-encoded https url}. Delivery body {"request_id","gateway_request_id","status":"OK"|"ERROR","payload":<output>|null,"error","payload_error"}. Verify ED25519 signature: headers X-Fal-Webhook-Request-Id, X-Fal-Webhook-User-Id, X-Fal-Webhook-Timestamp, X-Fal-Webhook-Signature (hex); keys at https://rest.fal.ai/.well-known/jwks.json. 15 s first-attempt timeout, retried with backoff up to 31 times; 3xx is a permanent failure.

usefulHeaders.X-Fal-Request-Start-Timeout: seconds; server returns 504 if not started by then
usefulHeaders.X-Fal-No-Retry: 1 disables automatic retries (default up to 10 retries on 503/504/connection errors)

fal.fileInputs: Every *_url / *_urls field takes a public HTTPS URL (presigned S3/GCS/R2 OK, no auth headers). Data URIs (data:image/png;base64,...) are accepted by models but fal warns against anything larger than a few KB.
fal.upload: Two-step: POST https://rest.fal.ai/storage/upload/initiate?storage_type=fal-cdn-v3 with JSON {"content_type","file_name"} (Authorization: Key) -> {"upload_url","file_url"}; then PUT the raw bytes to upload_url with Content-Type; use file_url (https://v3b.fal.media/files/...) as model input. Files > 90 MB: POST .../storage/upload/initiate-multipart?storage_type=fal-cdn-v3, PUT 10 MB parts to {upload_url_path}/{partNumber}{query}, then POST {upload_url_path}/complete{query} with {"parts":[{"partNumber","etag"}]}. Optional header X-Fal-Object-Lifecycle (JSON) on initiate. Delete: POST https://rest.fal.ai/storage/files/delete {"file_url"} (needs assets:write).
fal.outputMedia: Output URLs (v3*.fal.media) are public and kept per your retention setting (forever by default); download what you need.
fal.catalogApi: GET https://api.fal.ai/v1/models (no key needed for metadata; ?q=, ?endpoint_id= repeatable, ?limit=, ?cursor=, ?expand=openapi-3.0). Default listing shows only active endpoints; deprecated ones appear with ?q= or ?endpoint_id=. Per-endpoint OpenAPI: https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id={id}. Human/LLM docs: https://fal.ai/models/{id}/llms.txt (has the Pricing section).
fal.errors: 422 validation -> {"detail":[{"loc":["body","field"],"msg","type","url","ctx"}]}; branch on type, never parse msg. Check X-Fal-Needs-Retry header for retry decisions.

replicate.auth: Header "Authorization: Bearer $REPLICATE_API_TOKEN" (the Files API example also shows "Token"). Content-Type: application/json.
replicate.submitOfficialModel: POST https://api.replicate.com/v1/models/{owner}/{name}/predictions with body {"input":{...},"webhook"?,"webhook_events_filter"?:["start","output","logs","completed"]}. All models listed in this file are official models (no version hash needed).
replicate.submitVersioned: POST https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions with {"version":"<64-char id or owner/name:version>","input":{...}} for community models.
replicate.syncMode: Header "Prefer: wait" (default hold 60 s) or "Prefer: wait=n" with n in 1..60. If the model is not done in time the response is the in-progress prediction (status starting/processing) - keep polling urls.get. File outputs may already be present while status is still processing.
replicate.cancelAfter: Header "Cancel-After: 90s" / "5m" / "1h30m" (min 5 s) auto-cancels; deadline before start -> status aborted (not billed).
replicate.statuses: starting | processing | succeeded | failed | canceled | aborted
replicate.poll: GET https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions/{id} (or urls.get). Respect rate limits; backoff ~1-2 s for images, 5 s+ for video.
replicate.outputs: Shape is per model: most image/video models return a single URL string (output), some return an array of URL strings (output[] e.g. seedream, gpt-image, qwen). URLs are on replicate.delivery; API-created prediction inputs/outputs/logs are deleted after 1 hour by default (data_removed=true, output=null) - copy files out immediately.
replicate.fileInputs: Pass HTTPS URLs or data URIs (API spec: data URL for files <= 256 KB; guide says < 1 MB). For larger files use the Files API: POST https://api.replicate.com/v1/files multipart/form-data with part "content" (file, required), "filename", "type", "metadata" -> file object {id, urls.get, expires_at, checksums...}; pass urls.get as the input value.
replicate.webhooks: Body is the prediction object; events start/output/logs/completed (output/logs at most every 500 ms); redirects are not followed; verify with webhook signing secret (see docs/topics/webhooks/verify-webhook).
replicate.timeouts: Predictions time out after 30 minutes of running unless raised by support.

higgsfield.auth: Authorization: Key {api_key_id}:{api_key_secret} (keys from console.higgsfield.ai). Optional Idempotency-Key header on submit.
higgsfield.submit: POST https://api.higgsfield.ai/{model_endpoint_id} with the model input as raw JSON -> {"status":"queued","request_id","status_url","cancel_url"}
higgsfield.status: GET https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/{request_id}/status -> {"status":"queued"|"in_progress"|"completed"|"failed"|"nsfw"|"canceled","request_id","error","images":[{"url"}],"video":{"url"},"audio":{"url"},"audios":[...]}; poll 2 s growing to 10 s with jitter
higgsfield.upload: POST https://api.higgsfield.ai/files/generate-upload-url {"content_type":"image/jpeg"} -> {"public_url","upload_url","content_type","upload_headers"}; PUT bytes to upload_url with every upload_headers header (no API credentials); use public_url. Upload URL expires in 1 h. Types: image/jpeg|jpg|png|webp|gif, audio/wav|x-wav, video/mp4.
higgsfield.retention: Outputs available for at least 7 days.
